g.text: Central hub: nearly all tables FK here

svg.text: PostgreSQL for production (Azure Flexible Server with PgBouncer)
SQLite for local development (file-based) and CI tests (in-memory, StaticPool)
SQLAlchemy ORM abstracts the dialect — same codebase, different DB
Alembic migrations use batch_alter_table() for SQLite compatibility
All datetime columns stored as Text for cross-dialect safety
All user-owned tables FK to users with CASCADE delete (GDPR erasure)
audit_logs and ai_prompt_logs use NO FK on user_id — survives user deletion
Every repo.get_*/list_* MUST filter by user_id — P0 isolation rule
Partial unique index on email (NOT NULL only) — allows multiple NULL
Token tables (session, email, password reset) use SHA-256 hash as PK
Also: sandbox_events, sandbox_usage, reminder_dismissals, prompt_template_overrides, admin_audit_logs, affiliate_clicks, feedback_attachments
Every migration uses IF NOT EXISTS / IF EXISTS for idempotency. Production runs on container startup before Gunicorn forks.
Schema drift checked in CI against PostgreSQL 16 service container.
